description: Update a draft or scheduled API post (posted/processing posts cannot be edited). Send only the fields you want to change: content, platforms, mediaItems (replaces all media), scheduledFor, timezone, status (draft/scheduled), platformSettings (per-platform content via platformSettings.<platform>.content), or firstComments (replaces the auto-posted first comments; an EMPTY array clears them). Content is re-validated against platform rules; an invalid update is rejected. Changing scheduledFor on a live scheduled post re-dispatches it.

firstComment.description: Replace the auto-posted first comment on the main post (shorthand for firstComments: [{target: 0, text}]).

firstComments.description: Replace ALL auto-posted first comments ([{target, text}]). Pass an empty array to clear pending comments.

target.description: 0 = the main post (default); i = thread entry i+1 (create_thread on twitter/threads/bluesky only).

text.description: Comment text - links allowed, no media.

mediaItems.description: Replace all media (empty array clears media). Multiple items = carousel. For files on the user's device or attached in chat, call attach_media first (where available) to get urls.

caption.description: Optional caption/alt text for this item.

type.description: Media type. 'pdf' = a LinkedIn document post (linkedin only).

platformSettings.description: Per-platform overrides keyed by platform; platformSettings.<platform>.content sets per-platform text.

platforms.description: Replace the target platforms. Strings or objects (with accountId).

accountId.description: Specific connected account id (from list_accounts). REQUIRED when more than one account is connected on the platform (the API returns a 400 listing the choices rather than silently picking one); may be omitted only when exactly one account is connected.

content.description: Override text for this platform only.

postId.description: The id of the draft or scheduled post to update.

scheduledFor.description: New ISO 8601 schedule time (5 minutes to 90 days in the future).
